prompt: Create a hyper-realistic cinematic close-up portrait of a serious adult man in near-total darkness, cropped extremely tight on the right side of his face and left ear. He has short dark hair, thick brow, intense narrowed eye contact looking downward and forward, rugged skin texture, visible pores, light stubble, and a trimmed mustache. A single glossy white wireless earbud is inserted in his left ear, and one raised hand with long fingers is touching or adjusting it; count exactly 1 earbud and 1 visible hand. Use dramatic low-key lighting with a narrow hard key light from the front-left revealing skin texture, cheekbone, nose bridge, lips, ear, and fingers while the background falls to pure black. Composition should feel like a premium tech or audio advertisement: horizontal 16:9 frame, face occupying the right two-thirds, ear and hand on the left third, deep shadows, high contrast, muted natural skin tones, no text, no logos, no extra accessories. Make the image photorealistic, sharp, moody, and cinematic, with shallow depth of field and subtle specular highlights on the earbud and skin.

promptZh: 创作一张超写实的电影感特写人像，主角为 神情严肃的成年男子，背景近乎全黑。画面极度紧凑地裁剪在他面部右侧及左耳处。他留着深色短发，眉毛浓密，眼神专注且微微眯起，向下前方凝视，皮肤质感粗犷，毛孔清晰可见，带有淡淡的胡茬和修剪整齐的八字胡。他的左耳佩戴着一只光泽感十足的白色无线耳机，一只抬起的手正用修长的手指触碰或调整耳机；请确保画面中仅有 1 只耳机和 1 只可见的手。采用戏剧性的低调照明，从左前方投射一道窄而硬的主光，勾勒出皮肤纹理、颧骨、鼻梁、嘴唇、耳朵和手指，背景则完全隐入纯黑之中。构图应呈现出高端科技或音频广告的质感：16:9 横向画幅，面部占据右侧三分之二，耳朵和手位于左侧三分之一，深邃阴影，高对比度，柔和的自然肤色，无文字，无 Logo，无额外配饰。图像需具备照片级真实感、清晰度、氛围感和电影感，并带有浅景深效果，耳机和皮肤上需有细腻的镜面高光。
